AssayDetails: The samples were collected from the subjects following one-week run in phase on wash-out fluoride toothpaste. Prior to baseline subjects were asked to brush their teeth 12 +/- 1 hour prior to their appointment and refrain from oral hygiene and eating/drinking until after their appointment at study site the following morning. Drinking water was allowed until 2 hours prior to appointment. At this visit, baseline bacterial samples were collected (supragingival plaque samples from buccal surfaces of the upper right or left quadrant; on whole of tongue; from left or right side of buccal mucosa; from attached gingiva; saliva (oral rinse with 15ml of PBSTC solution). The samples were processed from bacterial counts and a subset for oral microbiome analysis. for bacteria enumeration.
typeOfSamples: Plaque, buccal mucosa, oral rinse, tongue and gingiva
